title: Runbook: Missing ConfigMap after deployment
content: If a deployment enters CrashLoopBackOff after a release, inspect envFrom and configMapKeyRef values first. A missing ConfigMap can prevent the container from starting. Restore the expected ConfigMap in the correct namespace, then restart the deployment and verify rollout health.

title: Runbook: Bad image tag or registry access
content: When a workload reports ImagePullBackOff, inspect the image field on the deployment, confirm the image tag exists, and verify the imagePullSecrets configuration if the registry is private. Patch the deployment to a known-good tag and confirm rollout status after the change.
